title: WorkspaceRoles
description: Output of `dmtool workspace roles <dir>` — the workspace roles lint (FEATURE-GAPS R3). Resolves every model's `roles` header annotation against the workspace roles.yaml and reports the cross-file inconsistencies the kernel can't see. A read, but it GATES: the process exits 1 when any finding is an ERROR (the envelope's `outcome` stays `read`; `valid` is false). The roles file is discovered under the workspace root (auth/roles.yaml, then import/auth/roles.yaml, then user/access-rights.yaml); `--roles` overrides discovery. Models are scanned recursively (a workspace is a tree; roles gate it workspace-wide).

root.description: the workspace root directory, as passed

rolesFile.description: the resolved roles file (relative to root when under it), or null when none was found or several were (see findings)

definedRoles.description: the roles declared by the resolved roles file (empty when none/ambiguous)

name.description: the role identifier a model's `roles` annotation binds to

description.description: the role's human description; absent when blank

accessRights.description: the access-right tokens the role carries

modelCount.description: number of document models scanned under the root

models.description: each scanned model and its gating roles (surface (c): which roles gate each model)

path.description: the model file's path relative to the scanned root

roles.description: the model's gating roles (the comma-split `roles` header annotation); empty if ungated

warnings.description: number of WARNING findings (do not fail the gate)

findings.description: the cross-file roles inconsistencies, in model then gating-role order

severity.description: ERROR fails the gate; WARNING does not

code.description: UNDEFINED_ROLE: a model gates to a role the file doesn't declare (the flagship — even the SME permits this). MISSING_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: a roles file is present but a model carries no `roles` annotation. NO_ROLES_FILE (warning): a model declares roles but no roles file was found. MULTIPLE_ROLES_FILES: more than one roles file (which governs is ambiguous).

modelId.description: the offending model's id; absent for workspace-level findings (NO_ROLES_FILE / MULTIPLE_ROLES_FILES)

modelPath.description: the offending model's path relative to root; absent for workspace-level findings

role.description: the undefined role name; present only for UNDEFINED_ROLE
